items.title: The same four descent statements for maps of algebras
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma is the algebra version of the four descent statements along a directed colimit: equality of two algebra maps, surjectivity, the existence of a map from a finitely presented algebra, and being an isomorphism (statement lines 32319-32346). The proof does not reuse the module statement blindly: it spreads finitely many algebra generators or relations out to one stage and uses a finite presentation of the target to construct the map there (proof lines 32348-32392). Handling generators as algebra generators rather than module generators is what the argument has to organise. H2.
